publicViewData.supported: Deep-frozen canonical scalars, plain or null-prototype records and arrays, with checked owned deferred Promises.
publicViewData.deferredPromiseAdmission: Owned deferred Promises expose controlled native s/v metadata accessors. Assignments preserve native async memo, await and writer behavior while checking and freezing values before publication. Arbitrary metadata, descriptor replacement and async iterable state are rejected.
publicViewData.authoredValues: Preserved unchanged; native hooks receive the checked public projection.
publicViewData.httpDataTransport: The shared rich codec and action HTTP transport retain their full value contract.
publicViewData.reason: Solid 2 RC.13 has no public projection hook before native border serialization reads properties; freezing rich mutable internal slots does not enforce snapshot safety.

limitations.worker: Not certified. Native request scoping uses @solidjs/web/storage and requires node:async_hooks AsyncLocalStorage support.
limitations.moduleFederation: Not certified. Cross-renderer remotes are rejected.
limitations.rawHydrationProtocolInjection: Unsupported. The owned producer writes only settled synchronous match records. Direct native writer injection of rejected whole-match Promises causes parser-time unhandled Promise errors; the native protocol defect is not fixed.
limitations.rawHydrationProtocolDiagnostic: ULTRAMODERN_SOLID_RAW_PROTOCOL_DIAGNOSTIC=1 node tests/ultramodern-renderers/solid-admission/run.mjs runs an optional raw native writer protocol diagnostic outside managed qualification.

blockers.publicRouteProjection: The owning managed pipeline and current packed native API pass immutable public snapshot, authored-original preservation, native Promise metadata, composed-context and raw-router rejection tests. Fresh final framework artifacts must requalify the generated public route pipeline.
blockers.supportedDeferredHydration: Managed native ESM SSR-to-browser fulfilled, held early rejection and real pending-stream late rejection pass, including native boundary reset, native router retry, cleanup and zero unhandled browser events. Fresh final-cohort and public generated-entry qualification remain required.
blockers.owningTransferControl: The owning managed pipeline proves critical failures before commit, deferred reader failure with zero getter/private bytes and settled-only whole-match records. Fresh packed artifacts must requalify the producer contract; raw writer injection remains unsupported.
